queries.result: First-party discovery identified the City of Buffalo GIS Maps page, the Erie County GIS Internet Mapping page, the Erie County parcel-data page, and the official Erie County ArcGIS parcel layer. The public service exposes polygon parcel geometry and safe native OBJECTID identifiers.

queries.result: The native/local-language discovery query did not identify a separate non-English local-language cadastral source; the first-party English Erie County GIS service remains the evidenced local custodian and public parcel source.

registryBasis: The City of Buffalo directs users to its Online Mapping Parcel Viewer and Erie County Online Mapping System; Erie County Office of GIS identifies the parcel layer and exposes a public ArcGIS polygon service. This evidences local/county cadastral-tax parcel custody, not legal title or guaranteed citywide completeness.

officialSources.observation: City of Buffalo official GIS page links the City of Buffalo Online Mapping Parcel Viewer and Erie County Online Mapping System.
Erie County Office of GIS says On-Map displays tax parcel data and identifies the Parcels layer as current to 2025.
Current first-party ArcGIS layer metadata reports esriGeometryPolygon, supported GeoJSON, max record count 1000, and spatial reference wkid 102717/latestWkid 2262.

requests.outcome: First-party City of Buffalo GIS page retrieved through discovery; links to the city and county parcel viewers.
First-party Erie County GIS page retrieved; identifies the county parcel layer and 2025 currency statement.
TLS-verified HTTP 200; polygon schema inspected. Safe schema fields included OBJECTID and SBL, but only OBJECTID was requested in geometry queries. Service CRS is wkid 102717/latestWkid 2262.
TLS-verified HTTP 200; bounded anonymous ID-only response returned a safe bounded response without address, owner, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields.
TLS-verified HTTP 200; bounded anonymous query returned two full Polygon features with native OBJECTID values 56840 and 56842. Retained sample has exactly one canonical id property per feature.
TLS-verified HTTP 200; exact WUP point query returned one Polygon feature with OBJECTID 335243. This is an exact-point observation only and is not used to infer citywide coverage.

source: Erie County Office of GIS / City of Buffalo official GIS links

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Erie County public parcel layer, identified by county GIS as current to 2025; City of Buffalo official page links the county mapping system.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public Erie County polygon service with bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry responses and exact-point response.

compositeKeyProvenance: No composite parcel key used. Retained sample identities are the service's native OBJECTID values; the 2262 service CRS was transformed by the public ArcGIS response to GeoJSON coordinates in EPSG:4326.

geometryQuality: Two full Polygon geometries retained from a bounded public response; no simplification or coordinate shift applied.
